claim: On this host on 2026-09-30 a names-only scan of every Codex shell_snapshots directory under the home directory, /tmp and /var/tmp (222 directories, 12 files) found 2 files that declared the Claude Code messaging-token variable, both dated 2026-09-27 in ~/.codex/shell_snapshots, of the 19 such files the 2026-09-29 sink inventory had counted there; no process held either open. After an announcement to the live peer sessions, the set was asserted by a digest of the enumerated paths and the 2 files were deleted by their literal paths at 03:02:25Z. The same scan afterwards found 10 files and 0 declaring the variable, and a names-only listing of ~/.codex before and after (21,042 and 21,040 entries) showed exactly the 2 snapshot files removed and no entry added.
limitations: Local observation on one host by names and counts only: no snapshot content or value was printed, and the scan decides a match by a line that starts with the variable's declare or export form, so a file that holds the value in another form is not counted.
The scan covers the home directory's .codex, .local/state, .local/share and code trees plus /tmp and /var/tmp; a Codex home elsewhere, or on another host, is not covered.

Why 17 of the 19 files counted on 2026-09-29 were already gone is inferred, not observed: Codex's own three-day snapshot retention (codex-rs/core/src/shell_snapshot.rs:105 at rust-v0.157.1) is the likely remover.
Deletion removes the files, not copies elsewhere: backups, a file-history snapshot or a sync of the home directory were not examined.
evidence_class: independent observation: names-only scans of this host's Codex shell snapshot directories and a names-only listing of the Codex home before and after a literal-path deletion

host_scope.identity: one workstation; the user's own Codex homes

before.scanned_at_utc: 2026-09-30T03:02Z (the set-assertion scan right before the deletion; a first scan at about 03:00Z gave the same counts)

deletion.set_assertion: the enumerated path list compared byte for byte with the two literal paths before rm
deletion.announced_to: the live peer sessions, including the Gate A owner, before the deletion

codex_home_listing.changed_mtime_only: 290 context-mode session -shm files, one sqlite -wal file and the shell_snapshots directory itself

data.configuration: [features] shell_snapshot = false in the host's base Codex configuration and its OmniRoute profile; Codex's default is on (codex-rs/features/src/lib.rs:1008-1011 at rust-v0.157.1)

commands: rm -- <the two literal paths from the list file>
provenance.withheld: the snapshot file names (they carry session identifiers) and the list file; the published counts come from the scans' own output
provenance.decision_record: docs/decisions/2026-09-29-key-management.md, section "Codex shell snapshots that recorded the messaging token (done, 2026-09-30)"
